gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Tests for {@link ByteOrderMark}, covering construction, matching, equality, hashing, and the various byte/string accessors.
ADDED i3: The predefined UTF_16LE constant always renders the same string regardless of any other instances created beforehand.
ADDED i4: An all-zero array shorter/different from the UTF_32LE BOM does not match.
ADDED i5: A BOM matches an array that begins with exactly its own bytes; here the BOM was built from an all-zero array, so the same array matches.
ADDED i6: Matching against a null array returns false.
ADDED i7: A BOM matches its own raw byte array.
ADDED i8: An array shorter than the BOM cannot match.
ADDED i9: hashCode can be computed without error.
ADDED i10: getBytes returns the UTF_32LE BOM as signed bytes (0xFF 0xFE 0x00 0x00).
ADDED i11: Two different BOMs of equal length are not equal, in either direction.
ADDED i12: BOMs of different lengths are not equal.
ADDED i13: A BOM is never equal to null.
ADDED i14: Constructing with an empty byte array is rejected with "No bytes specified".
ADDED i16: Constructing with an empty charset name is rejected with "No charsetName specified".
ADDED i18: getCharsetName returns the charset name supplied to the predefined constant.
ADDED i19: A BOM is equal to itself.
